question: Are Bald Eagle Peak South Spur and Southwest Route real distinct routes?
answer: No route by either name found in any source. The peak (6259 ft, between East and West Fork Foss River) has two known lines: the North Ridge (first climbed 1933, held as the Standard Scramble) and a southeast shoulder/ridge from the Necklace Valley trailhead side that Beckey rates class 3. Both shells are probably garbled attempts at that southeast line, and neither has a grade, track or text.
recommendation: Delete both shells. If the owner wants the second line, add ONE new row 'Southeast Ridge' (scrambling, Class 3) only after a trip report is read in full; I could not fetch SummitPost (403) or WTA (403) to fill it, so no fill proposed.
evidence: https://www.nwhikers.net/forums/viewtopic.php?p=192264 — two common routes, N ridge and SE shoulder; Beckey lists class 3 on SE ridge; no S/SW route
searched: Bald Eagle Peak Foss River south spur / southwest route — nothing
Bald Eagle Peak south ridge spur West Fork Foss Malachite — only SE shoulder + N ridge
